prompt: Seamless tileable texture seen straight from above: the flat top of an old stone wall, wet worn granite coping stones laid in a row with dark moss and lichen in the joints, a few broken brick edges, rain-dark, evenly lit with no shadows cast across it, fills the whole frame edge to edge.
